prose:
A Financial Times report indexed by Techmeme describes Amazon Employees for Climate Justice as a group of more than 1,000 employees increasing efforts to slow Amazon's data-center expansion and encourage debate over AI use. The excerpt places internal employee opposition alongside public resistance to rapid infrastructure growth.

The primary article could not be read in this pass. Membership size, campaign tactics, Amazon's response and evidence of any construction delays remain uninspected beyond the feed excerpt. Opposition is not evidence that a project has stopped, nor does the excerpt establish that every member takes the same position on AI. This entry records the reported organizing effort without supplying unavailable quotations or outcomes.
highlights: FT reporting is available here through a Techmeme excerpt
AECJ is described as having more than 1,000 members
The reported campaign concerns data centers and AI use
Tactics, company response and project outcomes were not inspected
An organizing goal is not a demonstrated construction delay
